The emblem of our prestigious college has been designed in a circle resting
on a raised surface with four pillars in each corner. The circle indicates
motion, prosperity, and continuity. The background encircled by the red sun
bears hope of light and knowledge. The sun is braced on either side by two
branches bearing leaves. In front of the sun is designed a bird in flight with
food in its beak which indicates the struggle for existence and pursuance of
knowledge. Just below the sun, two words in Sanskrit are attached (Bidya
Sadhoyote) which means 'knowledge is power' and is the only weapon to
achieve our goals and objectives. The establishment year of the college is
engraved in the lower foremost part of the emblem which marks the
initiation of higher and quality education in the greater Chhaygaon area.

        CHHAYGAON COLLEGE AT A GLANCE
         Chhaygaon College was established on 6th September 1974 at Chhaygaon of Kamrup
District, Assam, to promote higher education and install leadership quality among the human
resources to accelerate the nation-building process. The college is situated on the bank of the ever-
flowing Kalahi River, beside National Highway No. 17 at a distance of about 35 kilometres from the
L.G.B. International Airport, approximately in a distance 40 kilometres from Gauhati University. The
College stands on vast sprawling land, amidst lush greenery and shady trees. Chhaygaon is a place
that can boost with excessive pride in its ethnic and rich cultural diversities and also claims of rich
heritage to which ‘Chandika Devalaya’ and, Chanda Merghar stands as silent testimonials.
Chhaygaon College has been a trusted name for 50 years and is a premier institution that provides a
unique band of holistic education to nearly 4000 students who hail from in and around the greater
Chhaygaon area- a homeland of heterogeneous racial elements. The institution has been assessed
thrice and accredited ‘B’ Grade by NAAC in November 2004, 2015 and 2023 respectively, and also
recognized by the UGC 2 (F) and 12 (B) of the UGC Act, 1956.

        The Assamese Department provides a P.G. programme affiliated with Gauhati University.
Moreover, the college provides career-oriented programmes like PGDCA for the benefit of young
learners. The college also offers UG and PG courses under the banner of KKHSOU and IDOL.
Besides the regular courses, the college offers vocational subjects like Information Technology,
Computer application for self-employment, and entrepreneurship development. The faculty and
management body of the college leaves no stone unturned to flourish the potential of each of the
students. For the last 50 years, the institution has been successful in promoting an academic
environment in a large region.



                                         MISSION
To provide the students with knowledge, skills, values, and sensitivity to face the challenges in life
both in the academic field and in social and private lives. The college aims at providing high-quality
education and cutting-edge areas leading to the creation of a college where innovation, invention, and
entrepreneurship remain the cordial focus and thrust. The college strives to prepare the students to
face the challenges encountered in a competitive environment. The mission of the institution is as
follows:

    •   To impart quality higher education and educational innovations for academic excellence.
    •   To provide opportunities for the students to develop their personalities through community
        service and co-curricular activities like games & sports, music, art, culture, and literature.
    •   To promote an awareness and understanding of society and its numerous problems among the
        students.
    •   To attempt to evolve strategies for guiding and counselling students for self-employment and
        entrepreneurship development.
    •   To provide a forum for interaction and exchange of views among the teachers and students by
        organizing seminars, conferences, workshops, etc
    •   To equip the students to lead social life happily in peace and harmony.

         The undergraduate degree (UG) program in the “Four Year Under Graduate
Programme”(FYUGP) is a Choice Based Credit System under the Semester Scheme.
According to the guidelines, the four-year undergraduate program should provide a system of
several exit choices where the candidate has the option to exit after TWO, FOUR, and SIX
semesters of the program (at the end of each academic year After one year. Students will
obtain a certificate, two years, a diploma, and three years, a bachelor's degree, should they
decide to drop out. Bachelor with Research Distinction will be awarded to those who finish
all four years. Two consecutive (one odd and one even) semesters will make up an academic
year. A UG course shall be of eight semesters covering four Calendar Years (Academic
Sessions – July to June).
Duration of the course:
     i.     Odd Semesters (First, Third, Fifth, and Seventh) shall be July –December
     ii.    Even Semesters (Second, Fourth, Sixth, and Eight) shall be from January - June.

Each applicant must apply for admission throughout four separate academic semesters,
beginning with the first one. It will not be permitted for students to be admitted in the third or
fourth academic season if they do not enroll in the second academic session. A student will
also not be able to apply for admission in the fourth academic session if they do not enroll in
the third academic session. The program allows students to choose their courses horizontally.
By five years, they can pursue a three-year or six-semester program, and by seven years, a
four-year or eight-semester program. Students can retake the course within three years.
